dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...That sounds like something a drunk person would say.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: Hahahaha! Maybe. But compared to the real drunks I know, I hardly drink at all.

dialogues.speaker: Vakhrushina
dialogues.text: Good wine is wonderful and all, but I do still have work to get done.
